title: nan
key_contribution: Presents a high-resolution intensity LiDAR-inertial 3D mapping approach with novel cylinder feature detection for UAV-based aircraft inspection in GNSS-denied hangar environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
